chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, “What is the sign of the Imam who is to come after the Imam?”
So he عليه السلام said: “Purity of birth, good upbringing, and he does not engage in vain amusement nor play.”

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the divinely appointed Imam, the religious authority and proof of Allah
key_terms.الْمَنْشَإِ: upbringing, development, or mode of being raised
key_terms.الْوِلَادَةِ: birth or lineage, here indicating purity of birth
key_terms.طَهَارَةُ: purity, indicating freedom from defilement or impurity
key_terms.عَلَامَةُ: a distinguishing sign or mark by which something is recognized
key_terms.يَلْعَبُ: to play in a frivolous or unserious manner
key_terms.يَلْهُو: to engage in diversion or vain amusement

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the Imam who comes after the previous Imam in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states signs by which the Imam after the Imam is recognized: purity of birth, sound upbringing, and freedom from vain amusement and playfulness. It highlights the moral and existential distinction of the Imam within Shia theology of Imamate.
